style: Cozy picture-book mystery look with warm lamplight and friendly characters. Simple, clear shapes a 7-year-old can read from across a classroom.

assets.name: detective
assets.prompt: A friendly beagle detective standing upright on two legs, wearing a tan trench coat and a deerstalker cap, holding a big magnifying glass up near its face, curious smile. Full body from ears to feet.

assets.name: detective-aha
assets.prompt: The same beagle detective, full body from ears to feet, one paw pointing up in an excited 'aha!' moment, eyes wide and happy, magnifying glass in the other paw.

assets.name: office
assets.prompt: Empty background: a cozy detective's office wall. A big empty cork bulletin board fills the middle of the wall (no papers on it), wooden wainscoting below, a warm desk lamp glow at one side, a rainy window at the far edge. No people, no animals, no writing. 16:9.
